piTitle: Associate Professor in Evolutionary Developmental Biology
department: Department of Ecology, Evolution and Behavior (EEB)
institute: The Alexander Silberman Institute of Life Sciences
campus: Edmond J. Safra Campus, Givat Ram
tagline: Deciphering the Evolution of Arthropod Body Plans & Developmental Mechanisms
overview: Our laboratory investigates how complex animal body plans originated and diversified throughout evolutionary history. We primarily focus on the arthropods—the most species-rich animal phylum on Earth. By integrating comparative embryology, developmental genetics, functional genomics, and paleontology, we explore the developmental and genetic mechanisms responsible for evolutionary novelty, segmentation, and head patterning.
